propositions: A model class configured with provider='bedrock' and a canonical versioned Bedrock model id (containing a colon in the version suffix) silently drops the configured provider because _resolve_target treats any colon as a provider separator.
The bug affects only canonical Bedrock ids with version suffixes like v1:0; unversioned aliases without colons continue to work, which masked the issue.
The infer_provider function and _resolve_target each independently scanned for colons as the qualified/unqualified discriminator, causing the same defect to be unreachable via a single fix point.
An explicitly configured provider must be checked before scanning a model string for inline qualifiers to prevent any model id punctuation from discarding explicit configuration.
A provider-qualified string must not be double-prefixed; a conflicting provider configuration should raise rather than silently picking a winner.
